## Decision

Do NOT retract the AC-3 and AC-4 coverage claims. Both ACs are substantively discharged by work that exists and is green today; only their attributed slice ids are unresolvable. Record the defect as a compiler provenance gap instead. All 35 AC_COVERAGE events for this motive name slice ids absent from every surviving run ledger, because .groundwork/runs/ retains only 4 ledgers (none from the 2026-08-28/29 sessions) while the append-only journal keeps those sessions TASK_COMPLETE and AC_COVERAGE events forever. AC-1, AC-2, AC-5 and AC-6 were already retracted on 2026-09-04/05, leaving AC-3 (covering S0-PARITY-CORPUS, S4-PARITY-TEST, S3-HOOKS-FIX, S4-CORPUS-RECAPTURE-GUARD) and AC-4 (covering S0-INVENTORY, S2-MIGRATE) reading MET on unresolvable ids.

## Rationale

Measured, not inferred. AC-4 substance: test/gw/migrate/migrate.test.ts passes 21/21 with a real-corpus round trip asserting summary.lossy empty, per-motive lossy[] empty, total_motives >= 18, charter and ticket fm.id preserved, and ephemeral state untouched (legacy tracker, runs/ mtimes, journal/ mtimes, struggle-signals.jsonl). AC-3 substance: test/gw/parity/hooks.parity.test.ts plus test/gw/hook/corpus-replay.test.ts pass 213/213, replaying 70 recorded scenarios across 12 surfaces (stop-gate 9, nesting-guard 9, ledger-guard 8, ledger-bash-guard 8, piped-exit-code-guard 8, agent-model-guard 6, orchestrator-impl-guard 6, struggle-detector 6, session-reminder 4, comment-density-guard 3, commit-message-guard 2, session-commit-msg-installer 1) against both the old hooks/*.mjs surface and the new src/gw surface for identical verdicts. Root cause of the MET reading: hooks/lib/motive-compile.mjs:647-654 isCompleteAnywhereComposite resolves completion from journal TASK_COMPLETE events recorded at line 130 and from ledger status, and never requires the covering slice to exist in any ledger; line 826 then sets met = covering non-empty AND missing empty. Isolation proof: stripping only the six TASK_COMPLETE events for these ids in an offline copy flipped both ACs from met to unmet with missing listing all six ids, and restoring them restored MET. Retracting would assert these ACs are uncovered while their tests are green, converting a provenance defect into a false negative.

## Alternatives Considered

- Run journal ac-retract for AC-3 and AC-4 — rejected: records no-longer-covered, which is false; the work exists and its suites are green
- Re-point the coverage at current ledger slice ids — rejected: S18 already established this run covers zero of the motive 17 ACs, so there is no successor id to re-point to, and orchestrator-authored re-attribution escapes audit
- Leave the rows unexplained — rejected: a future session reads MET on ids no reader can resolve
- Delete or rewrite the offending shards — rejected: forbidden by D-27 append-only
